senses.gloss: f. (ἀρτάβη, Syr. ארדבא, ארטבא) Artaba, a Persian and Egyptian dry measure (v. Zuckerm. Jüd. Masse p. 47; Sm. Ant. s. v.).
units: <cite ref="Bava Metzia 80b">B. Mets. 80ᵇ</cite> <he>א׳ לעריבה</he> Ar. (ed. <cite ref="A00461"><he>אדריב</he></cite>) an Artaba is an unreasonable additional load for a small boat called Arebah.
<cite ref="Eruvin 102a">Erub. 102ᵃ</cite> Ar. (ed. <cite ref="A00461"><he>אדריבא</he></cite>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 20).
